caseNameFull: Bank of Commerce, in Error v. Charles S. Wiltsie, Prosecuting Attorney
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Indiana.
attorneys: Mr. Augustin Boice for plaintiff in error., Mr. Merrill Moores, Mr. W. L. Taylor and Mr. C. C. Hadley for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction on the authority of Erie Railroad Company v. Purdy, 185 U. S. 148; Mallett v. North Carolina, 181 U. S. 592; Mutual Life Insurance Company v. McGrew, 188 U. S. 291; and cases cited. See 153 Indiana, 460-474.
